findings.description: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so an argument without help yields (metavar, None) instead of an empty description as the new docstring promises.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with at least one positional argument that has help and another positional argument with no help. format_positionals then builds the records list from get_help_record for every argument, including the undocumented one, which becomes (metavar, None). That None is passed to formatter.write_dl, which wraps the description text, so it fails on None. The old code avoided this with the `or (arg.make_metavar(ctx), "")` fallback, which this change removed. Impact: help output for such a command crashes, or at minimum the row is not rendered as the title and docstring describe.
